an5.192:1.1: Atha kho Doṇo brāhmaṇo yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodi,
an5.192:1.2: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho Doṇo brāhmaṇo Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:-- 2.
an5.192:2.2: ‘na samaṇo Gotamo brāhmaṇe jiṇṇe vuddhe mahallake addhagate vayo-anuppatte abhivādeti vā paccuṭṭheti vā āsanena vā nimantetī' ti.
an5.192:2.4: na hi bhavaṃ Gotamo brāhmaṇe jiṇṇe vuddhe mahallake addhagate vayo-anuppatte abhivādeti vā paccuṭṭheti vā āsanena vā nimanteti.
an5.192:2.5: Tayidaṃ bho Gotama na sampannam evā ti.
an5.192:2.6: ‘Tvaṃ pi no Doṇa brāhmaṇo paṭijānāsī' ti? Yaṃ
an5.192:2.7: hi taṃ bho Gotama sammā vadamāno vadeyya
an5.192:2.9: mātito ca pitito ca saṃsuddhagahaṇiko yāva sattamā pitāmahayugā akkhitto anupakkuṭṭho jātivādena ajjhāyako mantadharo tiṇṇaṃ vedānaṃ pāragū sanighaṇḍukeṭubhānaṃ sākkharappabhedānaṃ itihāsapañcamānaṃ padako veyyākaraṇo lokāyatamahāpurisalakkhaṇesu anavayo' ti, mam'eva taṃ bho Gotama sammā vadamāno vadeyya.
an5.192:2.10: Ahaṃ hi bho Gotama brāhmaṇo ubhato sujāto
an5.192:2.11: mātito ca pitito ca saṃsuddhagahaṇiko yāva sattamā pitāmahayugā akkhitto anupakkuṭṭho jātivādena ajjhāyako mantadharo tiṇṇaṃ vedānaṃ pāragū sanighaṇḍukeṭubhānaṃ sākkharappabhedānaṃ itihāsapañcamānaṃ padako veyyākaraṇo lokāyatamahāpurisalakkhaṇesu anavayo ti.
an5.192:3.1: ‘Ye kho te Doṇa brāhmaṇānaṃ pubbakā isayo mantānaṃ kattāro mantānaṃ pavattāro yesañ c' idaṃ etarahi brāhmaṇā porāṇaṃ mantapadaṃ gītaṃ pavuttaṃ samihitaṃ tad anugāyanti tad anubhāsanti bhāsitam anubhāsanti vācitam anuvācenti, seyyathīdaṃ Aṭṭhako Vāmako Vāmadevo Vessāmitto Yamadaggi Aṅgīraso Bhāradvājo Vāseṭṭho Kassapo Bhagu,
an5.192:3.3: brahmasamaṃ devasamaṃ mariyādaṃ sambhinnamariyādaṃ brāhmaṇacaṇḍālaṃ yeva pañcamaṃ.
an5.192:4.1: Na kho mayaṃ bho Gotama ime pañca brāhmaṇe jānāma, atha kho mayaṃ brāhmaṇā tveva jānāma.
an5.192:4.2: Sādhu me bhavaṃ Gotamo tathā dhammaṃ desetu, yathā ahaṃ ime pañca brāhmaṇe jāneyyan ti.
an5.192:4.3: ‘Tena hi brāhmaṇa suṇāhi sādhukaṃ manasikarohi, bhāsissāmī' ti.
an5.192:4.4: Evaṃ bho ti kho Doṇo brāhmaṇo Bhagavato paccassosi.
an5.192:5.1: Kathañ ca Doṇa brāhmaṇo brahmasamo hoti?
an5.192:5.2: Idha Doṇa brāhmaṇo ubhato sujāto hoti
an5.192:5.3: mātito ca pitito ca saṃsuddhagahaṇiko yāva sattamā pitāmahayugā akkhitto anupakkuṭṭho jātivādena.
an5.192:5.4: So aṭṭhacattālīsavassāni komārabrahmacariyaṃ carati mante adhīyamāno,
an5.192:5.5: aṭṭhacattāḷīsavassāni komārabrahmacariyaṃ caritvā mante adhīyitvā ācariyassa ācariyadhanaṃ pariyesati dhammen'eva no adhammena.
an5.192:6.2: Neva kasiyā na vaṇijjāya na gorakkhena na issatthena na rājaporisena na sippaññatarena, kevalaṃ bhikkhācariyāya kapālaṃ anatimaññamāno.
an5.192:6.3: So ācariyassa ācariyadhanaṃ nīyādetvā kesamassuṃ ohāretvā kāsāyāni vatthāni acchādetvā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajati.
an5.192:6.4: So evaṃ pabbajito samāno mettāsahagatena cetasā ekaṃ disaṃ pharitvā viharati, tathā dutiyaṃ tathā tatiyaṃ tathā catutthaṃ. Iti uddham adho tiriyaṃ sabbadhi sabbattatāya sabbāvantaṃ lokaṃ mettāsahagatena cetasā vipulena mahaggatena appamāṇena averena avyāpajjhena pharitvā viharati.
an5.192:6.7: upekkhāsahagatena cetasā ekaṃ disaṃ pharitvā viharati, tathā dutiyaṃ tathā tatiyaṃ tathā catutthaṃ. Iti uddham adho tiriyaṃ sabbadhi sabbattatāya sabbāvantaṃ lokaṃ upekkhāsahagatena cetasā vipulena mahaggatena appamāṇena averena avyāpajjhena pharitvā viharati.
an5.192:6.8: So ime cattāro brahmavihāre bhāvetvā kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā sugatiṃ brahmalokaṃ upapajjati.
an5.192:6.9: Evaṃ kho Doṇa brāhmaṇo brahmasamo hoti. 4.
an5.192:7.1: Kathañ ca Doṇa brāhmaṇo devasamo hoti?
an5.192:7.2: Idha Doṇa brāhmaṇo ubhato sujāto hoti
an5.192:7.3: mātito ca pitito ca saṃsuddhagahaṇiko yāva sattamā pitāmahayugā akkhitto anupakkuṭṭho jātivādena.
an5.192:7.4: So aṭṭhacattāḷīsavassāni komārabrahmacariyaṃ carati mante adhīyamāno,
an5.192:7.5: aṭṭhacattāḷīsavassāni komārabrahmacariyaṃ caritvā mante adhīyitvā ācariyassa ācariyadhanaṃ pariyesati dhammen' eva no adhammena.
an5.192:7.7: Neva kasiyā na vaṇijjāya na gorakkhena na issatthena na rājaporisena na sippaññatarena, kevalaṃ bhikkhācariyāya kapālaṃ anatimaññamāno.
an5.192:7.8: So ācariyassa ācariyadhanaṃ nīyādetvā dāraṃ pariyesati dhammen'eva no adhammena.
an5.192:8.2: Neva kayena na vikkayena, brāhmaṇiṃ yeva udakūpassaṭṭhaṃ.
an5.192:8.3: So brāhmaṇiṃ yeva gacchati, na khattiyiṃ na vessiṃ na suddiṃ na caṇḍāliṃ na nesādiṃ na veṇiṃ na rathakāriṃ na pukkusiṃ gacchati, na gabbhiniṃ gacchati, na pāyamānaṃ gacchati, na anutuniṃ gacchati.
an5.192:8.4: Kasmā ca Doṇa brāhmaṇo na gabbhiniṃ gacchati?
an5.192:8.5: Sace Doṇa brāhmaṇo gabbhiniṃ gacchati, atimīḷhajo nāma so hoti māṇavako vā māṇavikā vā,
an5.192:8.6: tasmā Doṇa brāhmaṇo na gabbhiniṃ gacchati.
an5.192:8.7: Kasmā ca Doṇa brāhmaṇo na pāyamānaṃ gacchati?
an5.192:8.8: Sace Doṇa brāhmaṇo pāyamānaṃ gacchati, asucipaṭipīto nāma so hoti māṇavako vā māṇavikā vā,
an5.192:8.9: tasmā Doṇa brāhmaṇo na pāyamānaṃ gacchati. Kasmā ca Doṇa brāhmaṇo na anutuniṃ gacchati? Sace Doṇa brāhmaṇo anutuniṃ gacchati,
an5.192:8.10: tassa sā hoti brāhmaṇī neva kāmatthā na davatthā na ratatthā, pajatthā 'va brāhmaṇassa brāhmaṇī hoti.
an5.192:8.11: So methunaṃ uppādetvā kesamassuṃ ohāretvā kāsāyāni vatthāni acchādetvā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajati.
an5.192:8.12: So evaṃ pabbajito samāno vivicc'eva kāmehi . . . pe . . . catutthaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
an5.192:8.13: So ime cattāro jhāne bhāvetvā kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjati.
an5.192:8.14: Evaṃ kho Doṇa brāhmaṇo devasamo hoti. 5.
an5.192:9.1: Kathañ ca Doṇa brāhmaṇo mariyādo hoti?
an5.192:9.2: Idha Doṇa brāhmaṇo ubhato sujāto hoti
an5.192:9.3: mātito ca pitito ca saṃsuddhagahaṇiko yāva sattamā pitāmahayugā akkhitto anupakkuṭṭho jātivādena.
an5.192:9.4: So aṭṭhacattāḷīsavassāni komārabrahmacariyaṃ carati mante adhīyamāno,
an5.192:9.5: aṭṭhacattāḷīsavassani komārabrahmacariyaṃ caritvā mante adhīyitvā ācariyassa ācariyadhanaṃ pariyesati dhammen'eva no adhammena.
an5.192:9.7: Neva kasiyā na vaṇijjāya na gorakkhena na issatthena na rājaporisena na sippaññatarena, kevalaṃ bhikkhācariyāya kapālaṃ anatimaññamāno.
an5.192:9.8: So ācariyassa ācariyadhanaṃ nīyādetvā dāraṃ pariyesati dhammen'eva no adhammena.
an5.192:10.2: Neva kayena na vikkayena, brāhmaṇiṃ yeva udakūpassaṭṭhaṃ.
an5.192:10.3: So brāhmaṇiṃ yeva gacchati, na khattiyiṃ na vessiṃ na suddiṃ na caṇḍāliṃ na nesādiṃ na veṇiṃ na rathakāriṃ na pukkusiṃ gacchati, na gabbhiniṃ gacchati, na pāyamānaṃ gacchati, na anutuniṃ gacchati.
an5.192:10.4: Kasmā ca Doṇa brāhmaṇo na gabbhiniṃ gacchati?
an5.192:10.5: Sace Doṇa brāhmaṇo gabbhiniṃ gacchati . . . pe . . .
an5.192:10.11: So methunaṃ uppādetvā tam eva puttassādaṃ nikāmayamāno kuṭumbiṃ ajjhāvasati, na agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajati.
an5.192:10.12: Yāva porāṇānaṃ brāhmaṇānaṃ mariyādā, tattha tiṭṭhati taṃ na vītikkamati.
an5.192:10.13: Yāva porāṇānaṃ brāhmaṇānaṃ mariyādā, tattha brāhmaṇo ṭhito taṃ na vītikkamatī ti kho Doṇa, tasmā brāhmaṇo mariyādo ti vuccati.
an5.192:10.14: Evaṃ kho Doṇa brāhmaṇo mariyādo hoti. 6.
an5.192:11.1: Kathañ ca Doṇa brāhmaṇo sambhinnamariyādo hoti?
an5.192:11.2: Idha Doṇa brāhmaṇo ubhato sujāto hoti . . .
an5.192:11.4: So aṭṭhacattāḷīsavassāni komārabrahmacariyaṃ carati mante adhīyamāno,
an5.192:11.5: aṭṭhacattāḷīsavassāni komārabrahmacariyaṃ caritvā mante adhīyitvā ācariyassa ācariyadhanaṃ pariyesati dhammen'eva no adhammena.
an5.192:12.2: Neva kasiyā na vaṇijjāya na gorakkhena na issatthena na rājaporisena na sippaññatarena, kevalaṃ bhikkhācariyāya kapālaṃ anatimaññamāno.
an5.192:12.3: So ācariyassa ācariyadhanaṃ nīyādetvā dāraṃ pariyesati dhammena pi adhammena pi kayena pi vikkayena pi brāhmaṇim pi udakūpassaṭṭhaṃ.
an5.192:12.4: So brāhmaṇim pi gacchati, khattiyim pi gacchati, vessim pi gacchati, suddim pi gacchati, caṇḍālim pi gacchati, nesādim pi gacchati, veṇim pi gacchati, rathakārim pi gacchati, pukkusim pi gacchati, gabbhinim pi gacchati, pāyamānam pi gacchati, utunim pi gacchati, anutunim pi gacchati.
an5.192:12.5: Tassa sā hoti brāhmaṇī kāmatthā pi davatthā pi ratatthā pi, pajatthā pi brāhmaṇassa brāhmaṇī hoti.
an5.192:12.6: Yāva porāṇānaṃ brāhmaṇānaṃ mariyādā, tattha na tiṭṭhati taṃ vītikkamati.
an5.192:12.7: Yāva porāṇānaṃ brāhmaṇānaṃ mariyādā, tattha brāhmaṇo na ṭhito taṃ vītikkamatī ti kho Doṇa, tasmā brāhmaṇo sambhinnamariyādo ti vuccati.
an5.192:12.8: Evaṃ kho Doṇa brāhmaṇo sambhinnamariyādo hoti. 7.
an5.192:13.1: Kathañ ca Doṇa brāhmaṇo brāhmaṇacaṇḍālo hoti?
an5.192:13.2: Idha Doṇa brāhmaṇo ubhato sujāto hoti
an5.192:13.3: mātito ca pitito ca saṃsuddhagahaṇiko yāva sattamā pitāmahayugā akkhitto anupakkuṭṭho jātivādena.
an5.192:13.4: So aṭṭhacattāḷīsavassāni komārabrahmacariyaṃ carati mante adhīyamāno,
an5.192:13.5: aṭṭhacattāḷīsavassāni komārabrahmacariyaṃ caritvā mante adhīyitvā ācariyassa ācariyadhanaṃ pariyesati dhammena pi adhammena pi
an5.192:13.6: kasiyā pi vaṇijjāya pi gorakkhena pi issatthena pi rājaporisena pi sippaññatarena pi kevalaṃ pi bhikkhācariyāya kapālaṃ anatimaññamāno.
an5.192:14.1: So ācariyassa ācariyadhanaṃ nīyādetvā dāraṃ pariyesati dhammena pi adhammena pi kayena pi vikkayena pi udakūpassaṭṭhaṃ.
an5.192:14.2: So brāhmaṇim pi gacchati, khattiyim pi gacchati, vessim pi gacchati, suddim pi gacchati, caṇḍālim pi gacchati, nesādim pi gacchati, veṇim pi gacchati, rathakārim pi gacchati, pukkusim pi gacchati, gabbhinim pi gacchati, pāyamānam pi gacchati, utunim pi gacchati, anutunim pi gacchati.
an5.192:14.3: Tassa sā hoti brāhmaṇī kāmatthā pi davatthā pi ratatthā pi, pajatthā pi brāhmaṇassa brāhmaṇī hoti.
an5.192:14.6: ‘kasmā bhavaṃ brāhmaṇo paṭijānamāno sabbakammehi jīvitaṃ kappetī' ti?
an5.192:14.8: ‘seyyathā pi bho aggi sucim pi dahati asucim pi dahati, na ca tena aggi upalippati,
an5.192:14.9: evam eva kho bho sabbakammehi ce pi brāhmaṇo jīvitaṃ kappeti, na ca tena brāhmaṇo upalippatī' ti.
an5.192:14.10: Sabbakammehi jīvitaṃ kappetī ti kho Doṇa, tasmā brāhmaṇo brāhmaṇacaṇḍālo ti vuccati.
an5.192:14.11: Evaṃ kho Doṇa brāhmaṇo brāhmaṇacaṇḍālo hoti. 8.
an5.192:15.1: Ye kho te Doṇa brāhmaṇānaṃ pubbakā isayo mantānaṃ kattāro mantānaṃ pavattāro yesañ c' idaṃ etarahi brāhmaṇā porāṇaṃ mantapadaṃ gītaṃ pavuttaṃ samihitaṃ tad anugāyanti tad anubhāsanti bhāsitam anubhāsanti vācitam anuvācenti, seyyathīdaṃ Aṭṭhako Vāmako Vāmadevo Vessāmitto Yamadaggi Aṅgīraso Bhāradvājo Vāseṭṭho Kassapo Bhagu,
an5.192:15.3: brahmasamaṃ devasamaṃ mariyādaṃ sambhinnamariyādaṃ brāhmaṇacaṇḍālaṃ yeva pañcamam.
an5.192:16.1: ‘Evaṃ sante mayaṃ bho Gotama brāhmaṇacaṇḍālam pi na pūrema.
an5.192:16.2: Abhikkantaṃ bho Gotama . . . pe . . . upāsakaṃ maṃ bhavaṃ Gotamo dhāretu ajja-t-agge pāṇupetaṃ saraṇaṃ gatan'
